description: Processed InSAR images over Fentale Volcano, Main Ethiopian Rift is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by British Geological Survey. This data set contains 119 unwrapped and geocoded inteferograms derived from Cosmo-SkyMed (CSK) SAR scenes aquired over the Northen Main Ethiopian Rift between June 2014 and December 2015. This data set also contains displacement time series derived from processed CSK and Sentinel-1 inteferograms at the locations specified in the accompanying README files. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher British Geological Survey. Its tags are Fentale volcano, Northern Main Ethiopian Rift, Main Ethiopian Rift, InSAR, Geodesy. The repository dates the deposit 2019; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
